title: Scheduling, Shipping and Payment Terms for Specialty Pharmacy Program Fills
content:
## Scheduling and delivery

A Specialty Pharmacy Program refill reminder call is made the tier's number of refill-reminder days before the supply runs out. The fill is scheduled with the member at least the tier's refill-scheduling lead business days before delivery. It may be delivered:

- to the member's home;
- to the prescriber's office, where the tier allows delivery there;
- to another US address the member gives.

## What a fill may contain and how it ships

- Each fill is at most the tier's maximum days supply. A fill above 30 days is allowed only for drugs on the tier's list of drugs filled for up to 90 days.
- Drugs on the refrigerated list ship refrigerated.
- Injectables come with a sharps container where the tier provides one free.
- An adult signature is required where the tier requires one.

## Status of the enrollment

A fill is scheduled or shipped only while the enrollment is active. The enrollment's status in the system record decides this.

| Enrollment status | May a fill be scheduled or shipped? |
|---|---|
| active | Yes |
| referred, benefits verification, on hold or discharged | No |

## Balance and payment

A shipment waits while the member's combined specialty balance due exceeds the specialty credit limit. Each fill's cost share is due within the tier's payment-due days of shipment.

## Biosimilar switch

When the tier's biosimilar switch incentive is above zero months, a member who moves from a reference biologic to its paired biosimilar pays zero cost share on the biosimilar. This lasts for that many months, counted from the first biosimilar fill.

## Illustrations (assumed figures)

- *A request for a 60-day supply of a drug that is not on the tier's 90-day list.* The fill may not exceed 30 days.
- *A tier with a three-month switch incentive, and a member whose first adalimumab-adaz fill follows Humira.* The member's cost share on adalimumab-adaz is zero for three months from that first fill.
